main.description: What a private labeler publishes and accepts, with the fields of app.bsky.labeler.service minus its public-only parts.

reasonTypes.description: Report reason codes in scope. If not defined (distinct from empty), all are.

subjectTypes.description: Subject types (account, record, ...) this labeler accepts reports on.

subjectCollections.description: Record collections that can be reported. If not defined (distinct from empty), any.

labelKey.description: The did:key (P-256 or secp256k1) that signs this labeler's labels now. Published here instead of in the labeler's public DID document, which would mark the account as a labeler.

previousLabelKeys.description: Keys retired by routine rotation. Each verifies only labels whose cts is before its retiredAt. cts is chosen by the signer, so this is no defence against a leaked key: after a compromise, don't list it, and re-sign current labels. Requires labelKey; keys are unique.
